title: RRSI: 噪声带内的逐轮决策（port）
note: 旧入口保持为 HarnessGrad mode-A port：它移植逐轮规则，但平台只交付一个候选且无条件推进，因此仅重裁决、不执行原始 pool selection。独立的 methods/rrsi/fidelity.py 提供离线可测的 m-candidate selection、角色 prompt、校准和 reject-to-incumbent 语义；它不是 native reproduction，直到 study-only evaluate_many 与 method-owned deployment 接口、原始 scaffold/domain/model 对齐。

source.scope: native algorithm source audit; local checkout may contain unrelated uncommitted probes

preserved: annealed edit budget, stall/exploration reserve, novelty and pruning state
pre-evaluation deterministic plus model critic with bounded repair
noise floor, two-branch cost rule, and study-side score discipline
m-candidate argmax over admissible candidates and incumbent retention when none qualify (offline pure module)
adapted: HarnessGrad artifact/channel and configurable model, scaffold, domain evaluator and split
platform trial-spread calibration is an explicit provenance-labeled adapter
role prompts are compact adaptations of the upstream action contracts, not verbatim templates
missing token accounting is explicitly marked unavailable instead of using the upstream dC=0 substitution
missing_until_runtime_support: native m-candidate artifacts from one incumbent followed by trusted study-only evaluate_many
method-owned select/deploy result that can retain incumbent or deploy no candidate
native analyst/digester trace dispatch, git worktrees/frontier, and k trials inside the RRSI loop
full upstream role prompt bodies and domain-specific role briefs

deviations.what: The old mode-A port has no native candidate pool.
deviations.why: The current protocol returns one candidate trajectory and the platform owns measurement; the fidelity core therefore exposes selection as a pure function and records the runtime capability request in the task-local report.

deviations.what: Native scaffold and evaluator are not silently replaced.
deviations.why: The port keeps model, scaffold, domain evaluator and split configurable; a result is a decision-rule alignment measurement until those axes match the source instance.
